headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 13, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, securing a 14-5 victory. Henry Davis led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles dominating the game from start to finish. Leody Taveras led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Keegan Akin has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. Chris Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder impingement. Nick Lodolo has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a blister on his left index finger. William Kempner has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right elbow sprain. Brandon Woodruff has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. Anthony Banda has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left lat strain.

The Baltimore Orioles have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Cam Sanders, who was traded to the Orioles from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Houston Astros have traded SS Braden Shewmake to the Milwaukee Brewers. The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Toronto Blue Jays have traded RHP Tommy Nance to the Minnesota Twins for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. On the mound, Ryan Yarbrough earned the win, while Paul Blackburn earned the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Reds 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Alex Bregman leading the offense. Bregman hit a home run (9) on a fly ball to left center field, scoring Pete Crow-Armstrong and Seiya Suzuki.
